svg.title: A fallback answers less, and says so
svg.desc: Each square is one entry the registry could return. The console path and the booted runtime return all of them; the package-file fallback returns every declared entry but none of the dynamically registered ones, and the answer states that.

g.text: A fallback answers less, and says so
Every path runs outside this process; the shortfall travels with the result instead of being hidden.
one square = one entry the registry could return
A partial registry never looks complete: source, reason and the unread files travel with the result.
The two full paths differ in cost, not in what they know — which is why they are drawn identically.
